pinned.title: Lucky Sleuthers — The ARC 25 Have Been Notified
pinned.body:
The ARC request window for The Beautiful Beast is closed. Silver Spine Studio™ has selected twenty-five Lucky Sleuthers for early access, and selection notices have been sent.

If you requested an ARC, please check your email inbox — and look in Junk / Spam as well. Notices went out August 17, 2026 from contact@silverspinestudio.com.

Congratulations from Silver Spine Studio to everyone selected. Thank you to every reader who applied and took part — your support means more than you know.

Please keep an eye on silverspinestudio.com for updates and new release information. Official global release day is November 1, 2026 for the full digital edition, paperback, and hardcover.

Coming next for Extended Sneak Peek buyers: the Insider Deal window opens September 30 and runs through October 14, 2026. If you purchased the Sneak Peek, you are on the whitelist for the full digital novel at $14.99 during that window (regular digital price is $19.99 from November 1; paperback $24.99; hardcover $29.99).

Questions or concerns? Please reach out anytime at contact@silverspinestudio.com — we are glad to help.

Happy Sleuthing!

pinned.title: The Beautiful Beast — Launch Timeline & What’s Next
pinned.body: The road to release is mapped. Here’s the plan and how to get early access.
bullets: Digital full novel preorder + launch week events
pinned.expandBody:
Milestones

1. Cover Reveal — Aug 3, 2026. The blank ribbon falls away. The premium artwork is officially unmasked.
2. Sneak Peek Release — Aug 4, 2026. Digital Extended Sneak Peek (Prologue & Chapters 1–2) for $4.99. This purchase places you on the Insider Deal whitelist.
3. ARC Sign-ups — Aug 7 – Aug 14, 2026. Advanced Review Copy applications open to select 25 sleuths for early access. Selection emails go out Aug 17, 2026.
4. Teaser Trailer 2 Drop — Aug 21, 2026. Production loops push live.
5. ARC Delivery Window — Sep 21–23, 2026.
6. Full DIGITAL Preorder Goes Live — Sep 30, 2026. Whitelisted buyers lock in the $14.99 Insider Deal on the full DIGITAL copy through Oct 14, 2026 (save 40% vs digital retail $24.99).
7. Hardcover Orders Open — Nov 1, 2026. Print edition available for order on release day.
8. Launch Week Events — Oct 21–28, 2026.
9. Official Release Day — Nov 1, 2026. Full retail becomes $24.99.

A note for readers & gift-givers

• Begin with the Sneak Peek: $4.99 for Prologue & Chapters 1–2 — and your place on the Insider whitelist.
• Two paths to the full DIGITAL copy: Preorder Nov 1 – Dec 5, 2026 at $14.99, or full DIGITAL retail $24.99 from Nov 1, 2026. Hardcover orders from Nov 1, 2026.
• Holiday timing: Nov 1 release lands just as gift season begins — a Colorado thriller ready for the nightstand, the stocking, or the reader who loves a storm.
